powerSave.title: Keep app awake while agents work
powerSave.description: Prevent app suspension while agents run tool loops or other active work. Waiting for questions or tool approval still counts as idle.
powerSave.macNote: To prevent sleep in battery mode on macOS devices, including when the lid is closed, you must enable “Keep awake” mode in the bottom-right corner of the sidebar.

notifications.soundsDescription: Play a sound when the agent finishes work, asks a question, or encounters an error.
notifications.dockBounceDescription: Bounce the dock icon when the agent finishes, asks a question, or encounters an error while the window is not focused.

archived.title: Archived chats
archived.description: Archived agents are stopped and hidden from your chat list.
archived.loadFailedRetry: Couldn’t load archived chats. Please try again.
archived.empty: Chats you archive will appear here.
archived.deleteFailed: Failed to permanently delete the chat.
archived.deleteDialogDescription: This deletes the chat history and attachments. This action cannot be undone.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose whether StageVibe follows your system appearance or always uses light or dark mode.

colorScheme.title: Color scheme
colorScheme.description: Adapt the color style of your StageVibe setup to your liking.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the StageVibe interface.
